title: Membership in the Padded Language
statement: Let $L$ be a language of finite Boolean words, and let $C,c$ be natural numbers. For every finite Boolean word $x$, the pair encoding of $x$ and the all-ones word of length $C2^{(|x|+1)^c}$ belongs to the padded language of $L$ if and only if $x\in L$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language of finite Boolean words
replaced: Let $L$ be a language and $C, c$ natural numbers. For every binary string $x$, the pair encoding of $x$ with the all-ones pad of length $C\cdot 2^{(|x|+1)^c}$ belongs to the exponentially padded language of $L$ if and only if $x \in L$.
